content_sections.heading: About Madurai DHS
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Madurai District functions under the Department of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Tamil Nadu, and its District Health Office is at Viswanathapuram, Madurai. The notice carries the logos of the Government of Tamil Nadu, the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu and the Directorate of Public Health. According to the notice, the vacancies are in the offices of the Joint Director of Health Services, Madurai / Usilampatti, the Government Rajaji Hospital and the District Siddha Medical Office in Madurai district.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 12 vacancies across nine posts. The number of vacancies is tentative and subject to change. The vacancies at serial numbers 1, 2 and 3 (Medical Consultant (Yoga and Naturopathy), Ayush Medical Officer and Yoga Professional) will be filled on the basis of communal reservation. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of these posts. The Therapeutic Assistant vacancy is for a male candidate.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Qualification as printed: Post Graduate Diploma in Genetic Diagnosis Technology / Cyogenetics, Degree in Bio Technology / Human Genetic / Molecular Biology / Medical Laboratory Technician. Experience: One year Experience in Genetic Diagnosis research. Qualification as printed: Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Echocardiography / Echocardiography Technology / Cardiac Care Technology or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution / University with the prescribed practical training / Clinical experience in Echocardiography. Preference: preference may be given to candidates having relevant practical experience in Echocardiography service in Government or recognized healthcare institutions. The age limit differs from post to post. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. For the Therapeutic Assistant and Medicine Issuer posts, only certificates issued by the Government of Tamil Nadu are accepted. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice states that the number of vacancies and the salary are tentative and subject to changes. It does not mention any allowances. The appointment is on a contract basis and is purely temporary. The service will not be made permanent at any time. A voluntary consent letter (Undertaking) to join the post must be submitted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Madurai DHS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register your details in the Google Form that opens through the QR code printed in the notice; the notice makes this registration compulsory. The form address printed in the notice is docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScJNxHdbDtfu7Gl6Mr_n6f613Vsb4XKCnLKqUh-16kJoNiKqQ/viewform. Download the application form from https://madurai.nic.in/notice_category/recruitment/. Attach self-attested copies of all the certificates relevant to the post you are applying for. Submit the original application form in person or by post to: District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Society, District Health Office, Viswanathapuram, Madurai - 625 014. Make sure the application reaches the office by 7 December 2026, 5 PM; applications received after this will not be accepted. The same address is also printed in the notice as the place where the interview will be held. The interview date is not specified in the notice. Office phone number: 0452 2640778.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Madurai DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 tentative vacancies across nine posts, including 3 for Ayush Medical Officer and 2 for ECHO Technician.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 7 December 2026, 5 PM; applications received after that will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Ayush Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The Ayush Medical Officer post requires a Degree in BSMS, while the Medical Consultant (Yoga and Naturopathy) and Yoga Professional posts require a Degree in BNYS.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It is less than 59 years for posts 1 to 5, less than 40 years for Senior Lab Technician and Occupational Therapists, and less than 35 years for Audiologist cum Speech Therapists and ECHO Technician.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Rs.15,000/- for Therapeutic Assistant to Rs.40,000/- for Medical Consultant (Yoga and Naturopathy) and Ayush Medical Officer; the notice calls the salary tentative.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Register in the Google Form through the QR code, download the form from madurai.nic.in, and submit it with self-attested certificate copies in person or by post at the District Health Office, Viswanathapuram, Madurai - 625 014.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on a contract basis, purely temporary, and the notice states the service will not be made permanent at any time.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for the Therapeutic Assistant post?
faq.answer: The one Therapeutic Assistant vacancy is for a male candidate with the Diploma Nursing Therapist Course, with the certificate issued by the Government of Tamil Nadu only.

faq.question: Q9. Is reservation followed in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. The posts at serial numbers 1, 2 and 3 will be filled on the basis of communal reservation.
